title: Relative Mayer-Vietoris long exact sequence for higher direct images of a two-open cover
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter cohomology.tex (Cohomology of Sheaves), section on Mayer-Vietoris
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives the relative Mayer-Vietoris sequence 0 -> f_*F -> a_*(F|_U) plus b_*(F|_V) -> c_*(F|_{U cap V}) -> R^1 f_*F -> ... for a morphism of ringed spaces f : X -> Y and a cover of X by two open subsets, functorially in F (statement lines 805-818). The proof works on the level of an injective resolution: the absolute Mayer-Vietoris proof is reused to see that the degreewise sequence of sections over f^{-1}(W) is short exact for every open W, which yields a short exact sequence of complexes of direct images, and the identification of the cohomology sheaves with the higher direct images rests on the separate statement that restrictions of the resolution are again injective resolutions (proof lines 822-846). The functoriality assertion is carried over from the absolute statement without proof. The claim is H2: one reduction to the absolute case plus one identification of resolutions.
